name: ASME boiler and pressure vessel certification
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. BPVC certificate categories: Section I power boilers (S, A, E, M, PRT), Section IV heating boilers (H, HLW) and Section VIII pressure vessels (U, UM, U2, U3); BPVC certification covers design, fabrication, assembly and inspection during construction. Evidence: https://www.asme.org/certification-accreditation/boiler-and-pressure-vessel-certification
